description: This file contains implementation of transactional grain classes and related data structures for correctness testing in Orleans. It defines classes like BitArrayState and several grain types for managing transactional bit arrays, including MaxStateTransactionalGrain, DoubleStateTransactionalGrain, SingleStateTransactionalGrain, and the base MultiStateTransactionalBitArrayGrain. It also includes a serializable class for bit array state management with custom operators and methods.

classes.name: BitArrayState
classes.description: A serializable class representing a bit array with operator overloads, enumerators, and Indexer for managing and comparing bits.

classes.name: MaxStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain class that initializes multiple transactional bit array states for maximum state tracking.

classes.name: DoubleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain class that manages two transactional bit array states.

classes.name: SingleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain class managing a single transactional bit array state.

classes.name: MultiStateTransactionalBitArrayGrain
classes.description: Base grain class implementing transactional bit array management, providing methods to set bits and retrieve states.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Method to check equality between two BitArrayState instances.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the BitArrayState.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bit array.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Enumerates over the integer values in the bit array.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the bit array, with bits reversed.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a specified binary operator to two BitArrayState instances.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation lifecycle event for the grain, initializing logger.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method to verify grain responsiveness.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets a specified bit in all transactional states managed by the grain.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves current states from all transactional states managed by the grain.
